name: Snufflenose Command Stick
summary: In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix sends trained gophers after blueleaf tubers in Razorfen Kraul.

sections.title: A Rod for Rodents
sections.body: Mebok Mizzyrix has trained snufflenose gophers to find blueleaf tubers deep in Razorfen Kraul. The roots lie hidden beneath the thorny tunnels, where finding them is nearly impossible without help. Mebok, a merchant in Ratchet, avoids entering the quilboar dens himself. He gives adventurers the Snufflenose Command Stick to direct the gophers. From up to fifty paces away, the stick guides them to sniff out and uncover the roots.

faq.q: What is the Snufflenose Command Stick used for?
faq.answer: The Snufflenose Command Stick directs a trained snufflenose gopher to find hidden blueleaf tubers in Razorfen Kraul. Point it at a gopher, and it follows the scent and digs up the roots.

faq.q: Where do you obtain the Snufflenose Command Stick?
faq.answer: You obtain the Snufflenose Command Stick in Ratchet, just outside Mebok Mizzyrix's workshop. It comes with a crate holding a trained gopher and an instruction manual.

faq.q: Why does Mebok Mizzyrix want blueleaf tubers?
faq.answer: Mebok Mizzyrix seeks blueleaf tubers because they are rare delicacies that bring substantial profit from affluent culinary contacts around the world. They grow deep beneath the Barrens in quilboar territory, so he hires adventurers to gather them.

faq.q: Do you get to keep the stick after finding the tubers?
faq.answer: No. After gathering the requested tubers, you return the Snufflenose Command Stick and transport crate to Mebok in Ratchet with your harvest.

angles.text: Blueleaf tubers are prized as a culinary delicacy around the world. You need a trained animal and a handler's stick to find them, rather than ordinary kitchen tools.
